items.finding: The text notes that temperature sensitivity of OH bands poses a severe drawback for measuring aqueous solutions in NIR and MIR, requiring tempered sample holders.
items.how_it_applies: This suggests that temperature compensation or control should be tested when measuring aqueous sucrose concentration to mitigate OH band sensitivity.
items.limits_and_transfer_risks: The cited text addresses general aqueous solutions in biopharmaceutical processing rather than sucrose specifically, so transfer to this exact system requires validation.
